doc_title_en: Notice Regarding Modification of Dividend on Surplus (Interim Dividend) and Revision of Year-End Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
doc_title_jp: 剰余金の配当（中間配当）及び期末配当予想の修正（増配）に関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: 改定業績予想と連結配当性向40%目安に基づき、累進配当の基本方針に沿って修正

summary_en: Interim dividend raised to 120 yen per share from 110 yen forecast, and full-year dividend raised to 240 yen from 220 yen forecast. Total interim payout 8,503 million yen, effective December 1, 2026. Modification based on revised earnings forecast and target consolidated payout ratio of 40%.
summary_jp: 中間配当を110円から120円に、期末配当予想を220円から240円に引き上げ。中間配当金総額8,503百万円、効力発生日2026年12月1日。改定業績予想と連結配当性向40%目安に基づく修正。
